title: Sample – Paper Moon
notes: A made-up example so you can try everything: drag pages, swap images, press Play.

pages.title: Dawn
pages.description: Wide shot of the city at dawn; a lone figure on the bridge.

pages.title: Rooftop
pages.description: Night rooftop, the moon looks like it is cut from paper.

pages.title: Paper sky
pages.lyric: Fold the sky and pull it higher
pages.description: She reaches up and the sky folds like paper.

comments.text: Lucas, keep the fold or switch to a tear like in Bleeding Page?

pages.title: Lights
pages.lyric: Every light is on for you
pages.description: Band on stage, beams cut through the haze. Mr Hat on the right.
pages.flag: drink on stage – Lucas to OK

pages.title: Tram stop
pages.description: Two figures at the tram stop, one walks off.

pages.title: Moon
pages.description: The paper moon alone in a dark sky.

pages.title: Road
pages.description: Desert road leading to the horizon.

pages.title: Sunrise
pages.lyric: And the moon goes back to paper
pages.description: Everyone together on the skyline as the sun comes up.

pages.title: Post-credits
pages.description: Mr Hat picks up the paper moon from the ground and pockets it.
